case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for laying out your labour and steel costs so openly. We want to answer them with a fair solution for both family companies, one that keeps your shop busy and rewards the loyalty you have shown us.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On the price history:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 125.45; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 126.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. It rests on the claims above and gives you a clear price from the new date. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Before you decide, what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point.

Given our documented cost increases, a price reduction below the current level is impossible; to move closer to your target, we would need a commitment to higher volume. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our offer is a price of €137.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €134.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for your proposal and the offer of a binding volume of 8,150 units, which helps us move forward. Our family foundry takes great pride in our long relationship and the craftsmanship of our people. Please share the forecast data behind this volume so we can firmly plan our foundry's capacity. 

With the volume commitment and your Option A terms of 30 days net from 1 April 2027, we can offer a revised price of €135.80 per unit. For our offer, we set a price of €135.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for the forecast request and for the pride you take in your people's craftsmanship. A binding volume and steady work for your foundry is exactly what Option A is built around, and it also pays you faster, which you have asked us for.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your shop a binding volume with a shorter payment term, and we stay firm on the price level. Option B keeps the payment term you already know, for those who prefer it.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 127.00; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 127.67; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. That is our way of repaying the loyalty you showed us when you held the old price, as a fair, lasting solution for both family companies.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate the shorter payment term of 14 days in your Option A, which is a welcome step. Building on this and the binding volume of 8,150 units, we can lower our price to €134.20. 

For our current Angebot, we offer a price of €134.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. We still require the forecast data for this volume to properly plan our foundry's capacity. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Our family foundry values our long partnership and we look forward to continuing our work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for lowering the price again and for asking what volume we can commit to. You want steady work you can plan your foundry around, and that is what our proposal is built on.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your shop a binding volume with steady call-offs, so your capacity is planned and your people stay busy. We hold the price level because the proposal below is the one we can stand behind.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 129.76; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As a family firm that held the old price for us in a hard year, you deserve a partner who gives you work you can count on, and this proposal is our serious effort to build that together.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

Over the many years of our partnership, our foundry has always valued the close relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We acknowledge your improved price offer, but a 60-day payment term ties up too much capital for our family business. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary Angebot stands at a price of €135.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Our offer is valid for 7 days. As an alternative, if we return to the 14-day payment term you proposed earlier, we can make a further concession and lower our price to €133.50, offering a price of €133.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Furthermore, a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please provide the forecast data for the 8,150 units so we can firmly plan our foundry's capacity.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for the alternative with the shorter payment term, and for the way you put the long partnership first. That shorter term is what spares your family business the tied-up capital you described, and we accept it as you offered it.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your foundry the faster payment you asked for, at the price you named for that term.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 133.50; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.

If you confirm this as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

On your question about volume and forecast, the proposal above is what we are putting forward, and we would rather close it cleanly with you than keep the terms open.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
